title: Quebec’s police watchdog to investigate killing of 15-year-old boy by officers
summary: Police opened fire within seconds after responding to a report of masked teens, according to a resident The head of Quebec ’s police watchdog said it will investigate the death of a 15-year-old boy who was shot dead by officers, revealing that the only weapon recovered from the scene of the fatal shooting belonged to the police. At a rare news conference on Tuesday, Brigitte Bishop, director of the province’s office of independent investigations, said her unit would conduct an “impartial” investigation into the death of Nooran Rezayi.
